title: Protocol for multiplex (6-plex) measurement of anti-malarial antibodies
author: Kwadwo Kusi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jf2cjqe
materials: Biotin labeled Goat anti-human IgG (H+L) 2 mg/ml
Ag	Amount of Ag Ag concentraion (µg/ml)
Allow all reagents to warm at room temperature (RT, ~25˚C).
Determination of optimum antigen concentration for coating
Acquire data using the Luminex 200 system.
Quality control/quality management of Multiplexed assays

steps.title: Prepare Bead Aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare bead stocks for each antigen concentration.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge each bead stock for 5 min at 310xg.
Disperse bead pellets by sonication and vortex for at least 20 sec.
Dispense 200 µl (2.5x10^6 beads) of each bead stock (1.25 x 10^7 beads/ml).
Centrifuge the bead aliquots for 2 min at 11,300xg and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Activate Beads
steps.instruction: Activate the beads using Sulfo NHS and EDC.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 80 µl of activation buffer, sonicating and vortexing for at least 20 sec between washes.
After the final wash, aspirate supernatant and add 80 µl of activation buffer; sonicate and vortex.
Add 10 µl of 50 mg/ml Sulfo NHS, followed quickly by 10 µl of 50 mg/ml EDC, and mix by gentle vortex.
Incubate the suspension for 20 min (+/- 2 min) in the dark at RT, mixing gently by vortexing after 10 min.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Activated Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the activated beads and transition them to coupling buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge activated beads for 2 min at 11,300xg and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 250 µl of coupling buffer (50 mM MES, pH 5.0), vortex and sonicate for 20 sec.
Repeat the centrifugation and resuspension in coupling buffer for a total of two washes.
Resuspend the final washed beads in 100 µl of coupling buffer by vortex and sonication for 20 sec.

steps.title: Couple Antigens to Beads
steps.instruction: Couple the antigens to the activated beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl of antigen at the appropriate concentration in coupling buffer to the beads.
Mix by gentle vortex and incubate for 2 h with rotational mixing at RT.

steps.title: Wash and Store Coupled Beads
steps.instruction: Clean the coupled beads and store them in storage buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge coupled beads for 2 min at 11,300xg and aspirate the supernatant.
Add 1000 µl of wash buffer (PBS pH 7.4, 0.05% Tween 20) and resuspend by vortex and sonication for 20 sec.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 11,300xg and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 1 ml of storage buffer (PBS, 1% BSA, pH 7.4, 0.05% sodium Azide) by vortex and sonication for approximately 20 sec.
Centrifuge for 2 min at 11,300xg and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the coupled and washed beads in 1 ml of storage buffer.
Count beads diluted 1:10 using a haemocytometer to estimate concentration (beads/ml).
Adjust bead concentration if necessary.
Store coupled beads at 2-8°C, protected from light.

steps.title: Prepare Plasma Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare and dilute plasma samples and controls.

substeps.instruction: Thaw plasma samples on ice and centrifuge to remove debris.
Dilute test plasma and negative plasma samples (malaria-naïve) 1:400.
Dilute positive plasma samples (pooled hyperimmune) 1:10,000.
Add 50 µl aliquots of diluted plasma samples into duplicate wells of a 96-well filtered plate.

steps.title: Prepare and Add Bead Mixture
steps.instruction: Create a multiplex bead mixture and add to the plate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend each coupled bead set by vortexing/sonication and aliquot the volume required to provide approximately 1,250 beads per set in the final mixture into a 15 ml tube.
Calculate the volume of buffer needed to reach the total required volume (approx. 6 ml for one 96-well plate) and add it to the bead suspension.
Thoroughly vortex the diluted mixed beads suspension.
Aliquot 50 µl/well into the filtered 96-well plate containing diluted plasma samples using a multi-channel pipette.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate with plasma and beads.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1 h at 4°C, protected from light with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Detection Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply detection antibody to the beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads with 250 µl/well of wash buffer using a pressure suction system; repeat for a total of 3 washes.
Gently vortex the plate to resuspend beads.
Add 25 µl/well of 5 µg/ml detection antibody (1:200 dilution of stock).
Gently vortex and incubate for 1 h at 4°C, protected from light with aluminum foil.

steps.title: SA-PE Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply SA-PE substrate to the beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 times as previously described and gently vortex to resuspend beads.
Add 25 µl/well of 1:50 diluted SA-PE (substrate solution).
Gently vortex and incubate for 30 min at 4°C, protected from light with aluminum foil.
Add 25 µl/well of Stop solution to the plate.
